title: ornithopus exstipulatus var. pygmaeus
intro: Ornithopus exstipulatus var. pygmaeus, commonly known as  Dwarf Medick, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The plant is also believed to have therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral properties, which may aid in wound healing and immune system function. The bioactive constituents of Ornithopus exstipulatus var. pygmaeus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
